note: Тренировочные клипы: по одному на удар, из панелей листов движений. Это НЕ часть номера — это референс движения для репетиций, и складывается он в assets/train_clips/, а не в assets/video/. Модель и контракт — docs/atlas-api.md.
почему описание персонажа лежит здесь од: Потому что шесть копий уже разошлись. Листы движений генерировались по одному, и с каждым персонаж уезжал: к шестому листу вместо Лоэна вышел русый в тёмно-синем сюртуке. Здесь описание одно на все клипы, подставляется загрузчиком вместо {who}, и разойтись физически не может.
почему панели, а не лист: Лист целиком модель прочитает как сетку с текстом и честно её перерисует. Панели нарезает tools/cut_panels.py, по одной позе на файл. Но внешность с панелей брать нельзя — она на них неверная, и промпт это говорит прямо.
как считается темп: В промпте стоят {real} и {slow} — их подставляет src/train_clips.py из scenario/strikes.json: {real} это разница времён первой и последней доли клипа, {slow} это duration делённое на неё. Писать темп руками нельзя: сдвинется доля в сценарии, и промпт начнёт врать про замедление, а проверить это глазами на готовом видео невозможно.
как считаются номера картинок: {char} и {poses} тоже подставляет загрузчик, из фактического порядка отправки: сначала референсы внешности, потом панели. Писать «images 1-4» руками нельзя — добавится референс, и промпт начнёт показывать модели не на те картинки.
запреты: Отдельного поля запретов у модели нет — negative уезжает склеенным с prompt, см. docs/atlas-api.md. Здесь он лежит отдельно, потому что документирует замысел и проверяется тестами.
общий запрет: text, letters, numbers, captions, angle marks, dashed lines, arrows, grid lines, panel borders, watermarks, speed lines, motion trails, glowing aura, particles, camera movement, camera shake, zoom, cuts, scene changes, other characters, room interior, furniture, props, blond hair, brown hair, dark military greatcoat, black trousers

character.роли: lohen_splash_art.png — внешность и палитра, официальный арт, полный рост. spear_full.png — форма и пропорции оружия, чистый рендер на сером. Оба уже проверены на лимиты модели, см. assets/screenshots/MANIFEST.md.
character.описание:
A slim young male anime character with SHORT pale mint-green hair, one stray strand standing up, violet-pink eyes and pale skin. He wears a white and pale-blue long coat with gold filigree over a dark navy inner jacket, a deep blue outer coat panel with gold trim, a light blue half-cape hanging from his left shoulder, a white waistcoat and white trousers, and dark navy armoured boots reaching above the knee with pale grey soles and small teal gems at the knees. A dark navy gauntlet and shoulder plate on his right arm. Cool icy blue-and-white palette throughout.

His weapon is a polearm about 1.8 m long: a slim dark navy shaft with a silver middle section and a small gold spike at the butt end, topped by a LARGE ornate head in gold, navy and pale blue — a long tapering blade with flaring side wings. That head is wide and heavy: almost all the weight of the weapon sits at the tip end, and it swings like a weapon that is heavy at the far end.

clips.title: Вспышка 1: горизонтальный смах древком
clips.prompt:
{char} show WHO the character is and WHAT his weapon looks like. {poses} are the key poses of that same character, in order.

{who}

IMPORTANT: {poses} come from a technique sheet and their character design is WRONG — wrong hair colour, wrong face, wrong costume, wrong weapon. Use them ONLY for body position: the tilt of the torso, where the feet are, where the hands sit on the shaft, and the angle of the shaft. The character in the video must look exactly like the one in {char}.

He starts with the polearm held low and behind his left hip, head of the weapon slightly raised. His shoulders turn first and his arms follow; the shaft levels out horizontally and sweeps flat from his left to his right at head height, striking with the MIDDLE OF THE SHAFT, not the blade. His whole body stops dead at the moment of contact and holds. Then the head lifts and he settles forward. His forward hand does not fly through the air — the shaft slides through his grip, about 25 cm of it passing forward as the strike goes out.

The whole action takes {real} seconds in reality. Play it in slow motion, about {slow} slower, filling the clip.

Single continuous shot. Locked-off static camera on a tripod. Full body in frame the whole time, floor visible, headroom above the weapon. Plain dark blue-black background.

He turns away through his back — head leads first, then shoulders, then feet — and the polearm trails low and behind him with its head close to the floor, chasing his body rather than leading it. His forward hand stays near waist height throughout; the shaft slides forward through his grip, about 45 cm of it in total.

clips.title: Копьё в пол: перекрут, замах, удар в метку
clips.prompt:
{char} show WHO the character is and WHAT his weapon looks like. {poses} are the key poses of that same character, in order.

{who}

IMPORTANT: {poses} come from a technique sheet and their character design is WRONG — wrong hair colour, wrong face, wrong costume, wrong weapon. Use them ONLY for body position: the tilt of the torso, where the feet are, where the hands sit on the shaft, and the angle of the shaft. The character in the video must look exactly like the one in {char}.

He spins the polearm one full flat turn above his head, catches it, and raises it straight up vertically over his head with both hands high — the tallest silhouette of the whole scene — and holds it there dead still for most of a second. Then the entire shaft swings forward and down in one arc, passing IN FRONT of his body and never behind it, and the head drives into a mark on the floor between his feet; his knees bend to absorb the impact. Finally both hands come off the shaft and he stands free beside the weapon, which stands upright by itself with its head in the floor.

The heavy head makes the spin slow and the fall fast — the weight leads the movement.

The whole action takes {real} seconds in reality. Play it in slow motion, about {slow} slower, filling the clip.
